coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: 235 Berry
record.summary: A seven-story residential building at 235 Berry St.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint(s), not a hand trace or plan estimate. The underlying Assessor parcel is condo-mapped across many individually owned per-unit lots (confirmed against DataSF's Assessor parcel data), so no single blklot represents the whole building and the record cannot be tied to one Assessor lot the way a single-owner parcel can. Using the real building footprint from OSM instead of a fabricated or arbitrarily chosen 'representative' unit lot, the same pattern already used for Mission Bay's other condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon I, Madrone and Radiance, re-checked against DataSF's Assessor parcel data in September 2026; Avalon II and III are not condo-mapped, and Arden and One Mission Bay were not re-checked).

milestones.text: 235 Berry (Signature Development Group): SocketSite (Sept 26, 2006, headline 'Under 50% Sold?') noted that at least four of the six units released in June were still available and reported the developer was shooting for closings and occupancy by the end of 2006
235 Berry (Signature Development Group) completed: Skybox Realty's page says 'Built in 2007'

changes.text: 235 Berry's September 2006 sales report no longer sets an 'under construction' status the article doesn't state.

The map notes said 235 Berry is informally 'Signature II' to 255 Berry's 'Signature I'; no cited source uses those names, so the claim was withdrawn. The comparison with other condo-mapped towers no longer lists Avalon II and III, which are not condo-mapped. The 2007 completion milestone now cites Skybox Realty's 'Built in 2007', and the 2006 milestone cites the SocketSite post and no longer states 50% sold.
